scope: Bounded read-only form metadata extraction connected to synthetic mock questionnaire preflight.

environment.browser: Local Playwright Chromium with in-memory synthetic HTML

checks.target: bounded metadata parser, synthetic mock preflight integration, durable audit readback, and mock browser regression suite
checks.details: Root exact rebased candidate rerun: unit/integration 9/9 and browser 22/22 pass, 31 total. An initial combined run had test_playwright_actions_never_exceed_remaining_worker_budget fail at the existing 250 ms Chromium launch timeout; the isolated test then passed on both candidate and base main, and the full browser suite passed on repeat without code changes. Includes structured metadata inputs, attribute and option extraction, direct label/heading/legend text fail-closed behavior, nested and sibling span/output answer exclusion, malformed/ambiguous controls and bounds, sensitive/credential classification, no DOM interaction, analyzer-specific preflight gate, zero attempts/receipts, and durable audit readback.

checks.target: changed analyzer, mock integration, and tests

checks.command: Red-first unit and integration tests before implementation
checks.details: Initial unit run failed because form_analysis.py was absent; initial integration run showed missing audit metadata and a sensitive question passing preflight. Red-first browser regressions demonstrated sibling span/output and nested label span capture, then direct label and heading/legend text returning PASS with rendered values; these now yield UNKNOWN without serializing their text. The analyzer-specific optional-control preflight regression passed before the privacy fix.

acceptance.metadata_sources: PASS for safe browser attributes, option labels, and structured mock metadata. Browser DOM label, heading, legend, and nearby text content are not serialized; any non-empty label, heading, or legend makes analysis UNKNOWN because static text cannot be distinguished from a rendered answer.
acceptance.read_only_behavior: PASS; extractor only queries DOM metadata; synthetic browser test observed zero click, input, change, or submit events.
acceptance.privacy: PASS; current values, option values, password values, cookies, and credentials are never returned. Any non-empty rendered label, heading, or legend causes UNKNOWN without returning text; sibling text is never read.
acceptance.mock_preflight_connection: PASS; a malformed optional control leaves legal preflight otherwise PASS, while analyzer UNKNOWN blocks browser startup and yields REVIEW_REQUIRED with zero attempts and receipts; audit readback remains durable.
acceptance.scope: PARTIAL; browser DOM semantic text (labels, headings, legends, and nearby text) is intentionally unavailable to preserve the no-current-answer guarantee; structured synthetic metadata remains supported, and the slice is limited to metadata analysis.

limitations.whole_requirement: PARTIAL; this slice does not implement general form filling, OCR, taxonomy mapping, or broader application automation.

safety.external_requests: NONE; local fixture server and in-memory synthetic DOM only.
